company.name: Nautilus Biotechnology
company.shortDescription: Nautilus Biotechnology is a life sciences company that develops a platform for analyzing and quantifying the human proteome.
company.description: Nautilus Biotechnology develops a proteome analysis platform that uses single-molecule measurement and a method called Iterative Mapping to generate detailed digital counts of proteins and proteoforms in biological samples. The company offers an integrated system of instruments, reagents, and software designed for broad proteome coverage and reproducible quantitative data to support research use cases such as drug development, biomarker discovery, and exploratory biological studies. Nautilus creates reagent kits and fluidics systems that work with its optical imaging and analytical tools to process labeled probes and decode complex protein information. Its platform aims to support researchers in uncovering insights into protein behavior and disease mechanisms that are difficult to access with traditional proteomics approaches.

aiResearchSummary.text: Nautilus Biotechnology is developing systems and methods for computational decoding of biological, chemical, and physical entities and integrated on-chip single-molecule detection to analyze single analytes. Using systems and methods for biomolecule retention and biomolecule preparation, analyte detection systems, particle-based isolation of proteins, and systems and methods for surface structuring, they enable highly multiplexable analysis of proteins and proteomes and detailed characterization and localization of protein modifications.
